title: My Hobbies
text:
Hello. My name is Tom. I like sport very much. On Monday I play tennis with my brother. On Friday I swim in the pool.

I also like to draw. I draw animals and trees. My sister likes to read books. We are a happy family.

questions.text: What sport does Tom play on Monday?
What kind of person is Tom probably?
What can we say about Tom's family?
options: They seem to enjoy their free time.

a place with water where people swim
living things that are not people or plants
to make a picture with a pencil or pen

paragraph_translations: Cześć. Nazywam się Tom. Bardzo lubię sport. W poniedziałek gram w tenisa z bratem. W piątek pływam na basenie.
Lubię też rysować. Rysuję zwierzęta i drzewa. Moja siostra lubi czytać książki. Jesteśmy szczęśliwą rodziną.
